method:
m1_ledger (Claude, own code): the frozen mass test, its coefficients, and the (eta, p) translation of the
computed populations.  Items 1 and 3 of the brief.  Pure algebra; no Codex code imported or run.

Quoted inputs [Q] are marked with their source commit.  Output: ../results/frozen_test.json

item1.identity: (rho/s)/D = 1 + (mX/eps-1)(1-eta) + (2mX/eps) p, exact given Y_Q eps = D and the three-reservoir ledger
item1.charge_constraint: N_plus/Q_net = 1 - eta + p >= 0, so eta > 1 is legal when p > 0 (ed73791 remark confirmed)

old_target.note: the old target was NOT an object E/Q: D/Y_Q,old = 0.98592 m_X is a v-calibrated supplied mass per net charge (d71cc01 FIXED_YIELD_RESULTS: late_mass_per_object 18221.72 GeV vs object 17064.54)

item3.what_decides_eta: a formation ensemble: expanding 3D evolution from the actual (matched) release spectrum with the changed scalar cubic, giving the charge-weighted object spectrum y_Q and the core/tail membership; mask fractions (30-52%) and the fixed-profile pulses are not that ensemble
item3.what_decides_p: chemical relaxation of the Xbar inventory (number-changing 2<->4 and condensate-assisted channels, pt_relax) followed by annihilation/conversion with the ACTUAL heat R (vector heat ~ 1/e) and object capture; kin_solve (forced-thermal start, gas only) and c481530 (fixed profile, one pulse) are partial pieces
